content.text:
I couldn't find an item price on the home page, so I haven't changed or committed anything.

The home page (`apps/web/src/app/page.tsx`) only renders `<LandingPage />`. I searched `apps/web/src/components/landing` for prices, currency amounts and per-seat or per-month figures, and found nothing. The only prices in the web app are these two:
- `BillingPane.tsx` shows the per-seat unit price. It comes from billing data, not a hardcoded value, and it isn't on the home page.
- The `.agents/skills/stageshow/examples/` demos contain sample prices, but they are reference examples and don't appear on the home page.

Which price did you mean? A file path or the text shown next to it would be enough. If you meant the billing seat price, tell me, since that is configured in billing rather than in the UI.
